label: negative
description: CEI is ALREADY broken at N-1: balances[msg.sender] -= amount is written after the external call in before.sol. At N it is still after the call - the ordering did not change. The only diff between commits is an added Withdrawn event emission, which does not touch the write/call ordering.
why_labeled: 2b detects a REGRESSION - a write crossing from before a call to after it between commits - not a pre-existing broken state. Here the read-affecting write is after the call in both commits, so there is no ordering change for 2b to fire on. (Whether the standing vulnerability should be reported at all is a full-scan concern, not a commit-regression one; 2b is a diff rule.) The guard situation is also unchanged (never present), so 2a is irrelevant too. 2b MUST stay quiet.
